name: io.github.dancenitra/mnemo
description: Zero-dependency memory layer for AI agents: value-ranked recall, per-type decay, consolidation, and a first-class CORRECTION channel (revert, echo-guard, lineage-aware retract + re-derive) with tamper-evident erasure proof. 12 MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMO_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSON memory file the server persists to (defaults to ./mnemo_memory.json).

environmentVariables.name: MNEMO_ECHO_GUARD
environmentVariables.description: 1 (default) blocks a restated retired value from resurrecting a corrected fact; set 0 for legacy keyed supersession.
